sections.title: The quiet power *of plants*

image.alt: Shelves of herbal blends and tinctures beside the pastry case

body: Alongside our kitchen you'll find our Herbal Apothecary, guided by a Master Herbalist who believes in the quiet power of plants. Herbs have been used for generations to support balance, calm and everyday wellness, and we honor that tradition with respect and integrity.
Every blend is crafted with intention, using time-honored practices and quality ingredients, whether you are here for a cup of herbal tea or something to take home.

sections.title: Food should nourish *more than your appetite*

image.alt: The Veg Out sign: creative and fun vegetarian café

body: Veg Out started with a love for fresh, vibrant vegetables, bold flavors, and meals that leave you feeling good inside and out. Somewhere along the way, that love grew into an understanding that what we put into our bodies matters, and so does how it is prepared.

We believe vegetarian food should be exciting, satisfying and full of life. No shortcuts. No bland plates. Veg Out is a place to slow down, take a breath and enjoy something wholesome, where neighbors gather and conversations flow.

quote.text: Come as you are. Eat well. Feel good. Veg Out.
